newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank/Greece offers to inject funds via quick repo.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Greece offers to inject funds via quick repo.

text.p: The Bank of Greece offered to inject an unspecified amount of drachmas via a seven-day repo auction on Wednesday at 12.60 percent, it said in a statement.

"The Bank of Greece will conduct a fixed rate repo auction (volume tender) on Wednesday. The auction will involve the sale of government securities (book entry form) owned by credit institutions to the Bank of Greece with an agreement to repurchase on August 13," it said.
The selling price was set at 80 percent, and the repurchase price at 80.1933 percent, it said.
The minimum amount per bid is 500 million drachmas ($1.7 million).
"In case of oversubscription, bids will be satisfied pro-rata, with a minimum allotment of 400 million drachmas," it said.
Results of the auction will be announced no later than 1130 GMT (1430 local) on Wednesday.
